(GOV.UK / Environment Agency primary data; cross-ref Water Magazine 21 Aug 2026)
Cross-ref URL: https://www.watermagazine.co.uk/2026/08/21/prime-minister-steps-up-drought-response-as-national-drought-group-moves-to-weekly-meetings/

England drought — 21 August 2026:
- England's National Drought Group is moving to weekly meetings as drought conditions
  intensify. The group met on 20 August to assess conditions and coordinate action across
  government departments, regulators and water companies.
- 71.3% of England is in drought, with rivers, reservoirs and groundwater under pressure
  following the driest July in 190 years and five widespread heatwaves.
- Reservoir levels have fallen to 62.6%; river flows remain below those recorded during the
  2022 "flash drought".
- Nine water companies have introduced restrictions affecting around 29 million customers.
- The Environment Agency has recorded 226 drought-related incidents including algal blooms,
  low river flows and fish deaths.
(Morning cross-ref: PM chaired Cobra; £65m for farmers; 10 regions officially in drought.)
